meta.name: clean-code
meta.description: Write readable, maintainable code through disciplined naming, small functions, and clean error handling. Use when the user mentions "clean up this code", "this function is too long", "code smells", "naming conventions", "boy scout rule", "single responsibility", or "unit test quality". Also trigger when reviewing a pull request for readability, untangling a messy function, debating comment styles, or improving error-handling patterns. Covers SRP, comment discipline, formatting, and unit testing. For refactoring techniques, see refactoring-patterns. For architecture and dependency rules, see clean-architecture.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱代码改造成可读、可维护的整洁代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查或重构他人代码，追求可读性和可维护性
copy.tagline_en: Transform messy code into readable, maintainable clean code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review or refactor code and value readability and maintainability

howto.what: Claude 会帮你写出易读、好维护的代码：用有含义的命名、短小的函数、清晰的错误处理，并遵循童子军规则（离开时让代码比来时更干净）。
howto.when: 当你提到“清理代码”“函数太长”“代码坏味”“命名规范”“童子军规则”“单一职责”“单元测试质量”，或要求审查可读性、拆分混乱函数、讨论注释风格、改进错误处理时触发。

say.text: 帮我清理这段代码，让它更易读。
say.note: Claude 会应用命名、函数拆分等原则重构代码。

say.text: 这个函数太长了，帮我拆分成小函数。
say.note: Claude 会提取子步骤并命名。

say.text: 审查这个 PR 的可读性，指出代码坏味。
say.note: Claude 会评分并给出改进建议。
